$comment: so that UI chrome routes through the design-system color layer. A small set of
semantic colors are deliberately fixed rather than theme-derived. Each is approved
here by `path` + `symbol` + `purpose`; line numbers are never used, and a whole
The enclosing symbol is resolved as the nearest preceding `val` / `var` / `fun`
declaration, so renaming or moving a symbol invalidates its entry. An entry that
no longer matches any literal fails the gate, so the registry cannot rot.

approved.purpose: Default source-tile color when no visual color has been authored. Mirrors the v1 default in tastile-web, so changing the literal would break cross-repo parity.
User-selectable project color palette (Event set), mirrored from tastile-web ProjectColorRow.tsx. These are the choices offered to the user, not UI chrome, so they must stay fixed across themes.

Status semantic color mirroring the legacy MobileTokens.Status.started success-green. Moves to TastileStatusTokens when the timeline status palette is migrated; tracked with the design-token follow-up.
